mapper.sql: tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (position(lower(#{q}) in lower(code)) > 0 OR position(lower(#{q}) in lower(name)) > 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id,code,name,data_scope_type FROM iam_role WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM iam_role WHERE ORDER BY code,name, id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT role_id,permission FROM iam_role_permission WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND role_id IN #{id} ORDER BY role_id,permission
SELECT FROM iam_role WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT permission FROM iam_role_permission WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND role_id=#{id} ORDER BY permission
SELECT id FROM iam_tenant WHERE id=#{tenant} AND enabled=TRUE FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM iam_user u JOIN iam_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id AND ur.tenant_id=u.tenant_id JOIN iam_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id=ur.tenant_id JOIN iam_role_permission p ON p.role_id=r.id AND p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE u.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND u.id=#{user} AND u.enabled AND r.enabled AND r.protected AND p.permission='iam:security:admin') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM iam_user_role ur JOIN iam_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id=ur.tenant_id JOIN iam_role_permission p ON p.role_id=r.id AND p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE ur.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND ur.user_id=#{user} AND r.enabled AND p.permission='iam:role:write')
INSERT INTO iam_role(tenant_id,code,name) VALUES(#{tenant},#{code},#{name}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,code) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_role SET name=#{name},enabled=#{enabled},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND NOT protected
UPDATE iam_role SET version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND NOT protected
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iam_role_permission WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND role_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_role_change_audit(tenant_id,role_id,actor_id,action,before_json,after_json,trace_id) VALUES(#{tenant},#{id},#{actor},#{action},CAST(#{before} AS jsonb),CAST(#{after} AS jsonb),#{trace})
